uiConfig.name: Service Principal
uiConfig.description: Authenticate Microsoft Fabric SQL and OneLake access with a Microsoft Entra service principal

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.note: Enter the Microsoft Entra tenant ID for the service principal. Enable the Fabric tenant setting that allows service principals to use Fabric APIs.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.note: Enter the application (client) ID of the Microsoft Entra service principal.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.note: Grant this service principal Contributor or higher on both the Lakehouse source workspace and Warehouse target workspace, plus the required SQL permissions.
